notes:
Diastema 0.32.0-beta.7 (beta)

This beta is everything Diastema has, in one build: the stable version (through 0.29.10) and every beta since. An office that switches from stable to beta gets it. With Open Dental, the office works the way it does today.

Changed since 0.32.0-beta.6

- Card payments: a payment sent to the wrong terminal (or cancelled on the terminal) no longer locks Take payment on "Checking with Moolah". You can charge again right away. Within 90 seconds of the first one, Diastema asks "Are you sure?" so you check the patient wasn't charged twice; after that, no question.
- Card payments: if both charges do go through, both show a red "Possible double charge" tag, and Open Dental gets an alert (new switch under Open Dental alerts, on by default).
- Card payments: a payment Moolah never answers for closes by itself as not charged once the checks end (about 12 minutes), when Moolah shows no sale for it. No settling by hand.
- Payments page: the Open Dental column shows the chart number and name in green when the payment is in Open Dental, and a red No when it isn't. Post to Open Dental only shows for payments that aren't there yet.
- Payment plans: the first payment can be today. When it is, it's charged together with the down payment as one charge.

Before you switch

Coming from 0.32.0-beta.1 through beta.6: nothing to do; there is no database update in this beta.

Coming from stable: see the 0.32.0-beta.2 notes. A database update runs once at the first start and saves a copy of the database first (in the data folder's backups, named "before-v49"). Keep that copy.
